title: RAG-Based Documentation System + Project Cleanup Plan
summary: Complete implementation of living documentation system stored in Supabase RAG memory with automatic generation, Mermaid diagram support, semantic search, and comprehensive project cleanup plan

rag_documentation_system.supabase_schema: Complete database schema for living documentation with vector search
rag_documentation_system.n8n_workflow: Automated documentation generation pipeline from RAG queries
rag_documentation_system.setup_script: One-command setup for RAG population and initial generation
rag_documentation_system.system_design: Comprehensive architecture documentation with Mermaid diagrams

project_cleanup_plan.crew_consensus: All 9 crew members approved cleanup plan
project_cleanup_plan.execution_plan: Phased approach with clear steps and timeline

general_principles: Documentation as code - store knowledge in RAG, generate docs on-demand from semantic queries
Single source of truth prevents documentation bloat, inconsistency, and outdated information
Semantic search enables discovery by meaning rather than exact keyword matching
Mermaid diagrams auto-generated from system relationships tracked in database
Multi-audience support - same knowledge base, different presentations for users/developers/contributors
Progressive learning - crew memories automatically become searchable documentation knowledge
Fast-path execution - when tool demonstrates >2min latency, immediately use alternative approach
Project organization reflects system maturity - clean structure indicates production readiness
Living documentation grows with system - always current, never stale or outdated
applicable_scenarios: Any software project with extensive documentation requirements
Systems serving multiple audiences (end users, developers, contributors, enterprise)
Projects experiencing documentation bloat and maintenance burden
Teams needing always-current documentation that reflects system state
Systems requiring visual architecture documentation and diagrams
Projects with complex component relationships requiring clear visualization
Development teams with limited time for documentation maintenance
Open source projects needing contributor-friendly documentation
Enterprise systems requiring professional documentation standards
